description: Reverse-ETL sink: update existing Greenhouse candidates' tags and/or custom fields via PATCH /v1/candidates/{id}. Update-only, not an upsert -- candidates must already exist in Greenhouse.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row updates one existing Greenhouse candidate (matched via candidate_id_column).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_updated / rows_errored). No downstream data -- write side effect lands in Greenhouse.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

candidate_id_column.label: Candidate Id Column
candidate_id_column.description: Upstream column holding the Greenhouse candidate ID to update (must already exist in Greenhouse).

tags_column.label: Tags Column
tags_column.description: Upstream column holding tags to set. Replaces existing tags, does not merge.

custom_fields_map.label: Custom Fields Map
custom_fields_map.description: Upstream column -> Greenhouse custom field internal name.

max_rows.label: Max Rows
max_rows.description: Overall safety cap on rows per run.

name: Greenhouse Candidate Update
